stories.title: Uncontrolled DCM runs over three girls in Agra:Cold storage manager’s daughter dies, driver beaten by crowd; allegedly drunk
stories.summary: A speeding DCM ran over three girls in Agra on Saturday night. The 22-year-old daughter of a cold storage manager died in the accident, while two girls were injured. According to eyewitnesses, the accident took place at 9:10 p.m. Four girls were walking along the roadside in Kalindi Vihar, within the Trans Yamuna police station area. A speeding DCM then came from behind and hit all four of them. The manager's younger daughter was thrown some distance away, while his elder daughter became trapped in the DCM's front bumper. She was dragged for around 25 feet. Further ahead, the DCM driver also hit another vehicle. When passers-by raised an alarm, the driver abandoned the vehicle and tried to flee. People chased him, caught him and beat him. Police took the three injured girls to hospital, where doctors declared the manager's elder daughter dead. The accused driver has been detained. He was under the influence of alcohol. CCTV footage of the incident has emerged. Three pictures related to the incident... The injured girls are undergoing treatment. Police officers also reached the hospital. Now read the full details of the case Manmohan Singh, who lives in H-Block of Kalindi Vihar, is a manager at Prakash Cold Storage. In front of the Kaila Devi Temple, Khushboo Jurel (22) had come with her sister Bhoomi (18) and neighbour Shikha Kushwaha to see off her friend Nisha Chaudhary (20), a resident of Govind Colony. All of them were walking along the roadside when a speeding DCM arrived. Two girls were thrown some distance away The DCM hit all three girls. Khushboo was dragged along with the DCM, while Shikha and Nisha were thrown some distance away by the impact. The DCM then collided with another vehicle. There was an outcry after the accident. Passers-by caught the driver. Passers-by immediately took all three injured girls to the nearby Chauhan Hospital. As her condition was critical, she was referred to Atul Hospital in Hariparvat. Khushboo died on the way. The other two girls are undergoing treatment. Sister said, ‘We were out for a walk when we were hit from behind’ Khushboo's sister Bhoomi said, "We were walking in front of ICC School when the DCM driver hit us from behind. Nisha and my sister Shikha were with my elder sister. I moved to the side, so I was not injured." My sister Khushboo became trapped in the DCM. A man was at the spot. He pulled our sister out. He was the one who took everyone to hospital. My sister has died. She was pursuing an MCom." Driver was drunk Dinesh said, "The accident happened near my house. I was sitting at the shop when I received information that a vehicle had hit three girls from the colony. After the incident, residents of the colony caught the driver and handed him over to the police, and the vehicle is also with the police. People also beat up the driver." The DCM driver was drunk. There is a country liquor shop around 500 metres before the accident site. The DCM had come from that direction. It was travelling at a very high speed. The driver lost control, as a result of which he ran over the girls who were walking along the side of the road. The police have taken him into custody. Trans Yamuna police station in-charge Harendra Kumar said: Four girls had come to Kalindi Vihar for a walk. A DCM coming from behind then hit them. One girl died, while two injured girls are undergoing treatment. The body has been sent for a post-mortem examination. The driver has been arrested along with the DCM.

Car breaks divider railing and overturns, killing one, injuring four:Vehicle was travelling from Raebareli to Lucknow when accident occurred near Kalli West
stories.summary: In Lucknow, a speeding car went out of control at around 1.30 a.m. on Friday, broke through the divider railing and overturned on the other side of the road. Five people travelling in the car were seriously injured in the accident. All of them were taken to the Apex Trauma Centre at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGI). Doctors there declared Utkarsh (26), a resident of Rae Bareli, dead. The four other injured people are undergoing treatment. The accident took place near the Kalli West police outpost on Rae Bareli Road. The collision was so severe that the divider's iron railing broke, scattering its pieces along the roadside. The car was also badly damaged. A crowd gathered at the scene after the accident. One of the men in the car was trapped near the steering wheel. Police, with the help of local residents, pulled him out. He was then sent to hospital by ambulance. Four other people travelling in the car had also been injured. All of them were taken to the trauma centre for treatment. See three pictures of the accident... Outpost in-charge pulls the young man out with the help of local people As soon as information about the accident was received, Kalli outpost in-charge Abhyuday Gupta reached the spot. Seeing the young man trapped inside the car, he tried to pull him out with the help of local residents. After considerable effort, the young man was pulled out and sent to hospital by ambulance. The other injured people were also taken to the trauma centre by ambulance. Car overturned after breaking through railing, badly damaged Photographs from the scene show the car overturned. The vehicle's body was badly damaged. The iron railing installed on the divider was broken and bent at several places, with its pieces scattered along the roadside. In view of the seriousness of the accident, the fire brigade was also informed, but before the fire and rescue team arrived, police and local residents pulled the young man trapped in the car out. Utkarsh, who lost his life in the accident, was 26 years old and was reported to be a resident of Rae Bareli district. The other injured people are continuing to receive treatment at the hospital. The reason why the car went out of control has not yet been ascertained. The car's occupants were travelling from Rae Bareli to Lucknow.

stories.title: Varanasi firecracker blast CCTV footage emerges:Fire spreads after explosion, then house collapses, leaving people terrified
stories.summary: A three-storey house collapsed in an explosion at an illegal firecracker factory in the Sarnath police station area of Varanasi. Two people were seriously injured, two are missing and one person, identified as the main accused, Raju Khan, has been arrested. CCTV footage of the incident has now emerged, recording the scene. After the explosion, the house can be seen collapsing like a house of cards. Three minutes later, as the cloud of dust clears, the footage shows destruction all around. Blast occurred at exactly 4:42 p.m Raju Khan and his family had been making fireworks in Paigamberpur for the past several years. His three-storey house collapsed in a sudden blast on Thursday evening. The sound was heard several kilometres away. Several other houses were also affected. His wife, Chandni, and younger son, Adeeb, were injured and are in hospital. His mother, Munni, and elder son, Adil, are missing. CCTV footage of the incident has emerged. It shows that everything was normal at 4:42 p.m. on Thursday evening. At 4:42:49 p.m., a massive explosion and fire can be seen, after which the house is reduced to rubble. Camera installed at neighbouring bike mechanic's house Neighbouring bike mechanic, Shivpujan Prajapati, suffered considerable damage in the incident. A CCTV camera is installed at his house and captured the incident. The camera in his garden shows everything was normal until 4:42. But at 4:42:49, there is a loud explosion, followed by sparks and flames. Some items fall into the garden, after which darkness engulfs the scene. When the cloud of dust and gunpowder clears about three minutes later, the garden has been completely destroyed and there is debris everywhere.

stories.title: Crime Branch to probe codeine syrup case:Anti-narcotics team seizes 25,000 bottles in Kanpur; transporters under scrutiny
stories.summary: The seizure of 25,000 bottles of codeine-based cough syrup from the warehouse of Rajdhani Interstate Transport in Transport Nagar has triggered panic in the area. Following the confession of accused Mihir Kumar Thakur, a joint team of the Kanpur and Lucknow units of the Anti-Narcotics Task Force (ANTF) has been deployed in the area. Meanwhile, transporters’ records are being scrutinised discreetly as investigators probe the suspected supply network. The Crime Branch will now take over the investigation into the case. Intelligence agencies are also assisting in the investigation, while a team has been dispatched to another state to trace the suspected supply network. Investigators expect a major seizure there soon. 250 cartons seized in late-night raid Late on Thursday (8 Oct) night, the Narcotics Task Force raided a warehouse operating from a house in Dhaknapurwa, Transport Nagar, and seized 250 cartons of codeine-based cough syrup. The consignment contained Turbo-T syrup, which was found to contain codeine. Mihir Kumar Thakur, a resident of Magarpatti under the Rajnagar police station area of Bihar's Madhubani district, was arrested at the spot. On Friday (9 Oct) morning, a team led by Nitya Goswami, Circle Officer of the Lucknow ANTF unit, arrived in the city and questioned him. During questioning, Mihir allegedly revealed that codeine-based syrup had been stored at the Capital Interstate Transport warehouse in Transport Nagar for the past four years before being transported to different locations. He also named several transporters in the area who are suspected of involvement in the trade. Following these revelations, a joint team of the Lucknow and Kanpur ANTF units was formed to investigate the transporters' activities and trace the wider network. FIR filed on Sub-Inspector Aman Singh's complaint After seizing the consignment and taking the accused into custody, the ANTF team submitted a written complaint at Babupurwa police station. An FIR was registered against Mihir, Ashutosh Tiwari, Sumit Yadav and Pankaj Dheer on the complaint filed by departmental Sub-Inspector Aman Singh. Police Commissioner Raghuveer Lal said the Crime Branch, rather than the local police station, would investigate the case. Last year, the Food Safety and Drug Administration had also conducted raids over the alleged supply of drugs classified under the NDPS category under the guise of medicines. The investigation resulted in a case against 11 accused, including Vinod Agarwal, owner of Agarwal Brothers and a resident of Philekhana Patkapur, and his son Shivam Agarwal. That case was also handed over to the Crime Branch, which has already filed a 5,000-page chargesheet. Investigators will now examine whether the earlier case is linked to the latest seizure.

stories.title: CM Yogi to perform Kalash Sthapana today:Arrives in Gorakhpur for 2-day visit; to interact with teachers from 17 districts tomorrow
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will arrive in Gorakhpur on Sunday (11 Oct) afternoon for a two-day visit, during which he will perform the Kalash Sthapana ritual at Gorakhnath Temple on the first day of Sharadiya Navratri. The ritual will take place at the temple’s Shaktipeeth at 5 pm, following traditional customs and Vedic chants. The recitation of the Devi Bhagwat and Shri Durgasaptashati will also begin in the sanctum sanctorum as part of the special Navratri prayers for the welfare of all. On Monday (12 Oct), the Chief Minister will distribute agricultural input grants to farmers affected by natural disasters. He will also address a teacher-voter interaction programme organised by the BJP. After spending the night at Gorakhnath Temple, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will distribute agricultural input subsidies to farmers on Monday (12 Oct) to compensate for crop losses caused by floods, excessive rainfall and hailstorms in recent days. The distribution programme will be held at the Yogiraj Baba Gambhirnath Auditorium. Later, Yogi will address a teachers' voters' conference at Mahant Digvijaynath Park in the Ramgarhtal area. The event is being organised in connection with the Gorakhpur-Faizabad Teachers' Constituency MLC election to garner support for BJP candidate Dhruv Kumar Tripathi. BJP aims to mobilise 10,000-12,000 teachers Through the conference, the Chief Minister will campaign for BJP candidate Dhruv Tripathi, with preparations under way to bring together 10,000 to 12,000 teachers. The Gorakhpur-Faizabad Teachers' Constituency covers 17 districts and has more than 54,000 voters. The Samajwadi Party has fielded Dr Sanjayan Tripathi, while independent candidates Ajay Singh and Rajiv Yadav are also in the contest. The BJP is stepping up efforts to secure victory for its candidate.

stories.title: Officers joining BJP succeed in politics:Officials who formed own parties struggle; 2 IAS officers to contest elections for first time in 2027
stories.summary: Two IAS officers and two PCS officers are preparing to contest elections for the first time in the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Over the past 12 years, 14 IAS and IPS officers have entered politics, but those who succeeded were the ones who joined the party in power. Those who chose a different path by forming their own parties remained entangled in the political quagmire. This raises a big question: Is this transition from bureaucrat to politician merely a new route to power and privilege, or is it a genuine attempt to change the system? Perhaps this is why, after IAS officer Divya Mittal announced her entry into politics, Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party (SBSP) chief Om Prakash Rajbhar took a dig at her. Becoming an IAS officer is easy, but contesting an election and becoming an MLA is difficult… She must have plenty of money, which is why she is contesting elections. Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, former bureaucrats are once again preparing to switch from khaki to khadi. What has been the success rate of bureaucrats in Uttar Pradesh politics? Let's find out in today's Sunday Big Story… The trend of officers entering politics after leaving government service over the past 12 years has produced three outcomes: IAS and IPS officers who succeeded in politics Close to the PM in Gujarat, later became Energy Minister in UP Arvind Kumar Sharma tops the list of officers who succeeded quickly in politics. He first became District Magistrate of Mehsana in 1995. In 2001, when Narendra Modi was Chief Minister of Gujarat, Sharma was appointed secretary in his office. Until 2014, he remained one of Modi's closest officials in Gujarat. When Modi became Prime Minister, Sharma also moved to the Prime Minister's Office. In 2020, he became secretary in the Ministry of MSME. He took voluntary retirement in 2021 and became an MLC in Uttar Pradesh in 2022. He was appointed Energy and Urban Development Minister in the Yogi Adityanath Cabinet. There is speculation that he may contest an Assembly election for the first time in 2027. Left his job in January, became a minister in March Asim Arun is the Social Welfare Minister in the Uttar Pradesh government. His father, Shriram Arun, was also an IPS officer. Asim served for long periods in Aligarh, Agra and Gorakhpur. He was considered a close officer of the chief minister. Asim was part of the Special Protection Group's close-protection team and served in the security detail of former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh. Towards the end of his career, he served as ADG of UP Dial 112 and became Kanpur's first police commissioner. Asim took voluntary retirement in January 2022 and won the Kannauj Sadar Assembly seat on a BJP ticket. The BJP appointed him Minister of State in the Social Welfare Department. He is expected to be in the electoral contest again this year. Investigated major cases in the ED, became an MLA soon after leaving service Rajeshwar Singh studied engineering at IIT Dhanbad and later pursued studies in law and human rights. After being promoted from the Provincial Police Service (PPS) to the IPS, he joined the Enforcement Directorate (ED) in 2007. He subsequently became the ED's Joint Director. He investigated several high-profile cases, including the 2G spectrum case, AgustaWestland, Amrapali and the Gomti Riverfront project. Although he had 11 years of service remaining, he took voluntary retirement in February 2022. He contested the Sarojini Nagar seat in Lucknow on a BJP ticket and became an MLA. He is again a contender for 2027. Left the IPS and defeated the former PM's son Satya Pal Singh was born in Basauli village in Baghpat district. He studied at Delhi University and the University of Wollongong in Australia. He served as Joint Commissioner of Police in Mumbai before becoming Mumbai Police Commissioner. While holding that post, he resigned at the age of 59 and joined the BJP. He became an MP from Baghpat on a BJP ticket and was appointed Minister of State in the Ministry of Human Resource Development in 2017. He was re-elected in 2019 but did not contest in 2024. He spent 10 years in politics after leaving government service. Former UP DGP became a BJP Rajya Sabha MP Brij Lal served as police chief in several districts. When Mayawati became Chief Minister in 2007, she appointed him ADG (Law and Order). He became Uttar Pradesh DGP in 2011. After retiring in 2015, he joined the BJP. He first became chairman of the Uttar Pradesh Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes Commission. In 2020, the BJP sent him to the Rajya Sabha. He was not nominated for another Rajya Sabha term in 2026. Born in Haryana, worked in UP and became a politician there Panna Lal Punia, also known as PL Punia, earned a PhD from Lucknow University. He became an IAS officer in 1970 and served in the Uttar Pradesh cadre. He held senior administrative responsibilities under the governments of Mulayam Singh Yadav and Mayawati. After retiring, he joined the Congress. He became an MP from Barabanki in 2009. After losing the 2014 election, the Congress nominated him to the Rajya Sabha. He is currently away from active politics. His son, Tanuj Punia, won the Barabanki seat in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections on a Congress ticket. Officials who formed parties but never contested elections Formed a party and challenged CM Yogi Amitabh Thakur held various responsibilities in the police department. In 2015, he claimed that Mulayam Singh Yadav had threatened him over the phone. After a video of the conversation went viral, Amitabh was suspended. In 2021, the Union Home Ministry compulsorily retired him, stating that he was not suitable to continue in service for the remainder of his tenure. In August 2021, Amitabh Thakur formed his own party, Azad Adhikar Sena. He announced that he would contest against Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath but later did not contest. In 2024, the Election Commission registered the Azad Adhikar Party. The party has not contested any election so far. Formed a party after campaigning for a separate state Sulkhan Singh served as Superintendent of Police in several districts before becoming IG in Lucknow, ADG, and Director of Police Training, and finally Uttar Pradesh DGP in 2017. He retired in the same year. Six years later, in 2023, he formed the Bundelkhand Loktantrik Party. Sulkhan Singh was demanding a separate Bundelkhand state comprising 15 districts of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh. He announced that his party would field candidates in 2024, but ultimately did not put forward any candidates. He continues to demand a separate state, although his party has not achieved any electoral success so far. Those who contested elections but suffered heavy defeats Contested three elections after forming a party; received just 643 votes in one of them Dr Chandrapal served in Uttar Pradesh before becoming Principal Secretary at the Centre. He retired in 2008 and formed a party called Adarsh Samaj in 2009. He contested the reserved Agra seat himself and received 1,093 votes, accounting for 0.17% of the total votes cast. Chandrapal did not contest any election in 2014. In 2019, he contested the same seat again and received 2,802 votes. In 2024, he received just 643 votes. Chandrapal's party has failed to achieve electoral success in nearly 17 years. Lost elections, formed a party and eventually joined the BJP Ram Bahadur was an IAS officer of the Uttar Pradesh cadre. He served as District Magistrate of Gonda and later as Vice-Chairman of the Lucknow Development Authority. He was considered close to Mayawati, and after retirement, her party fielded him from the reserved Mohanlalganj seat in 2014. However, he lost the election. He also lost the Mohanlalganj Assembly seat in 2017. He subsequently formed the Nagrik Ekta Party and contested from Gonda in 2019, but lost again. He joined the BJP in 2022. In 2025, he was appointed Associate Vice-President of the Uttar Pradesh Olympic Association and given responsibility for Gonda. Lost three elections, married at the age of 81 SR Darapuri was allotted the Uttar Pradesh cadre and retired as an IG in 2003. After retirement, he worked on human rights, Dalit rights and the rights of tribal communities. He contested the Lok Sabha election from the Robertsganj seat in Sonbhadra in 2009, 2014 and 2019 but never finished among the top five candidates. His highest vote tally was 11,032 in 2019. He subsequently left politics. In 2024, at the age of 81, he married an ASHA worker from Lakhimpur Kheri who was 40 years younger than him. Contested from the place where he had served as DM, finished 10th When the Ayodhya movement took place in 1992, Vijay Shankar was the District Magistrate of Faizabad. After the demolition of the Babri Masjid, he played a role in the rehabilitation of affected Muslim families. Between 2007 and 2012, he served as Principal Secretary in Mayawati's government, although he was removed from the post in 2011 and transferred to the Board of Revenue. He attracted attention by publishing a list of what he described as Uttar Pradesh's most corrupt IAS officers. After retiring in 2015, he formed the Lok Gathbandhan Party. He toured Himachal Pradesh and some other states and fielded candidates but failed to achieve success. In the 2019 Lok Sabha election, Vijay Shankar contested from the Ayodhya seat himself and received just 2,056 votes. He did not contest any further elections. Served as Chief Secretary under the SP government, failed to become an MP due to cross-voting Alok Ranjan served as Joint Secretary in the Defence Ministry of the Central Government. When Akhilesh Yadav became Chief Minister in 2012, Ranjan served as Principal Secretary and later Chief Secretary in his government. He oversaw projects such as the metro and the Lucknow-Agra Expressway. After retiring, he became a chief adviser to the SP. In 2024, the party nominated him for the Rajya Sabha, but he lost due to cross-voting. He was not nominated this time. Alok Ranjan remains with the SP and is preparing its strategy for 2027. Now, the IAS officers who may contest Assembly elections… Seeking a ticket from the place where she brought water after Independence IAS officer Divya Mittal is from Rewari in Haryana. When she became an IAS officer in 2013, she was allotted the Uttar Pradesh cadre. She served as District Magistrate in several districts, but her tenure in Mirzapur was particularly notable. The village of Lahuriyadih was struggling with a water shortage, and she arranged for water to reach it. She was transferred on the very day the water supply was inaugurated. In August this year, she resigned from government service. On September 29, she announced her entry into politics. She has not yet said that she will join any particular party, although parties have expressed interest in bringing her on board. She is likely to contest from Mirzapur. Suspended over alleged negligence, preparing to contest elections Abhishek Singh, from Jaunpur, is the son of former IPS officer Kripashankar Singh. His wife, Durga Shakti Nagpal, is also an IAS officer. During the 2022 elections, Abhishek was appointed an observer. After he posted on social media with an official vehicle, the Election Commission removed him from his assignment. In 2023, he was again absent from duty, leading to his suspension. He submitted his resignation to the Central Government this year. Since 2024, he has been involved in social service. There had been speculation that he would contest the 2024 elections, but that did not happen. He may enter the electoral contest in 2027, although the party he might contest for has not yet been decided. Joined the BJP seven years ago but has not contested an election Dr Surya Kumar Shukla held several positions in the police department before becoming chairman of the Police Recruitment and Promotion Board. In August 2018, he wrote to the Chief Minister, saying that he wanted to play an active role in the BJP's election campaigns after retirement. He retired in 2018 and joined the BJP the following year. The party has not given him a ticket so far. Two PCS officers preparing to contest elections

stories.title: Akhilesh skips Congress lunch:Why was tuning missing between ‘two boys’ at Delhi protest?
stories.summary: The Congress-Samajwadi Party (SP) protests against the Chief Information Commissioner in Delhi have intensified. Although the demonstrations are said to involve all constituent parties of the INDIA alliance, the Congress appears to be playing the leading role. The SP initially joined the protests on the streets but later appeared to lose interest. Akhilesh Yadav said he had a fever, but it is being speculated that he is upset over recent remarks by Congress leaders. Despite the Congress's invitation, no SP MP attended the lunch held in Delhi on September 30. The Congress clarified that the invitation had been sent late. These are just a few indications. Three more incidents have emerged that suggest growing differences between the two parties: In Parliament, the Congress is the largest opposition party with 90 MPs, while the SP ranks second with 37 MPs. At present, Akhilesh Yadav is the strongest face in the INDIA alliance. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), a member of the alliance, has been reduced to 3 seats, while the Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) has just 4. Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool Congress (TMC) won 29 seats in West Bengal, but has been unable to retain its MPs. In this situation, when the protests began in Delhi, it was natural for everyone to watch the leaders of both parties closely, whether it was Akhilesh and Rahul Gandhi's movements on the streets or their meetings and lunch gatherings. The Congress has consistently asserted that it is a national party and that decisions will be made accordingly. Akhilesh, meanwhile, has repeatedly said that the issue is not the number of seats but winning them. Responding to this, Congress MP Imran Masood said that if the party does not have seats, how can it win? Let's understand the growing friction between the two parties in 3 steps... 1. The day of the INDIA alliance meeting Akhilesh declined to attend A meeting of the INDIA alliance was scheduled for September 30 in Delhi. The decision to hold it had been taken on September 26. However, Akhilesh Yadav declined to attend on September 28. The party cited the nomination of its Rajya Sabha candidates in Lucknow as the reason. The Congress felt that September 30 was the first day for Rajya Sabha nominations and that the process could have been scheduled for another day. However, the SP sent 2 MPs to represent the party at the meeting. They were Harendra Malik, MP from Muzaffarnagar and the party's national general secretary, and Maulana Mohibullah Nadvi, MP from Rampur. It was decided that day that MPs from the INDIA alliance would march from Parliament House to the Election Commission of India office in Delhi on October 6. 2. The day of the protest Akhilesh was unaware, while Rahul and Priyanka went to Akashvani When the march began on October 6, Akhilesh Yadav and all SP MPs reached Parliament House. Akhilesh then set out for the Election Commission alongside Rahul Gandhi, accompanied by the other MPs. However, there appeared to be a lack of coordination between the SP and the Congress. The leaders of the other parties did not seem to know what to do if they were stopped from reaching the Election Commission. When the police stopped the march, Akhilesh sat down in protest at that spot. Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, meanwhile, went to Akashvani and staged a sit-in there. Other opposition leaders were reportedly not even informed about this move. It is said that the incident also upset the SP chief. 3. The day of Kharge's lunch The SP was absent, with the Congress saying the invitation was sent late On October 7, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge invited MPs from the INDIA alliance to lunch. However, the SP did not attend. When questions were raised in the media, Congress media in-charge and general secretary Jairam Ramesh issued a clarification on social media. He wrote on X: “All INDIA alliance parties were invited to today's lunch. However, the decision to hold the lunch was taken late last night, and the information was shared at the same time. It was therefore natural that representatives of some parties could not attend. Some media organisations are making unnecessary comments about this. All INDIA alliance parties stand united against vote theft, SIR and delimitation. They stand firmly alongside one another.” Three more reasons are being cited for the growing differences... 1. Congress is demanding a respectable number of seats in Uttar Pradesh Congress leaders have been engaged in a tussle with the SP over seat-sharing for the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. UP in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam initially demanded 200 seats, then reduced the demand to 150. Imran Masood has now called for the party to be given a respectable number of seats. This would mean one seat in every district and more than one in Amethi, Saharanpur and Rae Bareli. There is discussion within the SP about where the Congress would find suitable candidates when it does not even have candidates for 11 Legislative Council seats. 2. The Congress was not consulted over the Rajya Sabha candidate For the Rajya Sabha election, the SP nominated businessman and Reliance Industries director Dhanraj Parmal Nathwani. Dhanraj's father, Parmal Nathwani, had won a Rajya Sabha election in Jharkhand after defeating the Congress candidate with BJP support. It is being reported that Rahul Gandhi was not consulted about the nomination. 3. Imran's appointment as working president Over the past few months, Congress MP Imran Masood has directly targeted Akhilesh Yadav in his statements. Initially, it was believed that these were Imran's personal views. However, when the Congress appointed him working president of its Uttar Pradesh unit, SP leaders felt that his remarks had been made at the party's direction. Akhilesh said his health was not permitting him to participate... During the October 6 protest against the Election Commission, Rahul Gandhi stood on the barricades. When Akhilesh Yadav was reminded about this after arriving in Lucknow and asked why he had not done the same during the previous protest, he said his health was not permitting him to do so. When asked why he had skipped Kharge's lunch, Akhilesh said that, for now, it was lunch diplomacy, and dinner would follow later. He also said that the shape of the INDIA alliance would become clear very soon. What do political observers think? ‘The alliance is a necessity for both the Congress and the SP’ Senior journalist Hisam Siddiqui, who closely follows the Congress, said that Akhilesh not attending Rahul's meeting, the lack of coordination during the protest and the SP's absence from the lunch were not particularly significant issues. Such things would continue to happen before elections, he said, adding that they would not affect the SP-Congress alliance. Both the Congress and the SP need the alliance. At the national level, the SP is the largest party in the INDIA alliance after the Congress. If the SP itself leaves the alliance, what would remain of it? ‘Akhilesh Yadav is fighting for political survival’ Senior journalist Yogesh Mishra, who closely follows the SP, said that Akhilesh Yadav was fighting for his political survival. To achieve this, he would have to align with the Congress. It is true that differences between the two parties have become visible over the past few days, he said, but the Congress's support is essential if they are to challenge the BJP in Uttar Pradesh.

stories.title: UP unlikely to see biting cold this winter:El Nino may keep temperatures 2°C higher; summer could arrive early
stories.summary: October's intense sunshine is causing people to sweat. Usually, daytime temperatures in October remain between 31°C and 33°C, while night temperatures range from 20°C to 22°C. At the beginning of the month, days are slightly warm, but a mild chill begins to be felt at night. This time, however, temperatures are running 1°C to 2°C above normal. Daytime temperatures are reaching 33°C to 35°C, while night temperatures are hovering around 22°C to 24°C. Similar conditions are expected to be felt this winter as well. Meteorologists attribute this to El Niño, which is active in the Pacific Ocean. According to scientists, its effects will continue until February 2027. As a result, the chances of severe, bone-chilling cold are low. Cold wave conditions are also unlikely to last very long. Temperatures will begin rising rapidly from March 2027. Read the full report… In plains regions such as Uttar Pradesh, cold waves do not arrive suddenly. Their origins lie thousands of kilometres away in the Mediterranean region. Cyclonic systems that develop there, known as Western Disturbances, reach India's mountainous states, including Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand, bringing snowfall. The snowfall causes temperatures in these areas to fall below zero. That is when the real process begins. After the snowfall stops, extremely cold and dry winds move down towards the plains after passing over the snow-covered areas. There are no major mountain ranges or other significant barriers to stop these icy winds on their way, allowing them to sweep across the whole of Uttar Pradesh. How El Niño will obstruct cold winds Fog will not be as dense, and there will be fewer ‘cold days’ During winter, there are 10 to 15 days in December and January when the sun does not appear throughout the day. Dense fog covers the region in the mornings and at night, while cold winds cause people to shiver throughout the day. When the daytime temperature remains below 10 degrees, the Meteorological Department classifies the conditions as a ‘cold day’. The weather department forecasts that there may be fewer cold days this winter. Senior Skymet Weather meteorologist Mahesh Palawat explains that dense fog prevents much of the sunlight from reaching the ground. As a result, daytime temperatures also remain extremely low. How El Niño may prevent dense fog from forming Under the influence of El Niño, winter temperatures could remain 1°C to 2°C above normal. Dense fog, however, requires moisture in the air and low temperatures. If dense fog does not form, the skies will remain clear. Direct sunlight will reach the ground, and severe cold is unlikely. Temperatures will rise rapidly during the last 15 days of March The onset of summer is generally considered to begin towards the end of March. Temperatures gradually rise during the month, although daytime temperatures usually remain between 32°C and 35°C. The effects of El Niño, active in the Pacific Ocean, are expected to continue until February-March 2027. As a result, temperatures are likely to rise rapidly during the last 15 days of March. Warmer winter conditions will affect wheat and mustard crops Uttar Pradesh is India's largest wheat-producing state. Wheat crops need cool weather during February and March for grain filling and ripening. If winter temperatures remain even 1°C to 2°C above normal, the wheat growth cycle will become shorter. A lack of soil moisture and an early rise in temperatures could cause crops to mature prematurely. This may result in thinner grains and lower yields. These methods can be adopted to protect crops… Preserving moisture is most important: Dr Dinesh Shah, a professor in the Department of Agriculture at Banda University of Agriculture and Technology, says that El Niño could cause fields to dry out more quickly. Therefore, instead of repeatedly ploughing the fields, farmers should carry out light tillage using a rotavator or harrow, followed immediately by planking to lock moisture into the soil, before sowing. This will help preserve soil moisture. Sprinkler or drip irrigation should be used to conserve water. Control weeds immediately: During dry conditions and periods of low water availability, weeds absorb much of the water and nutrients intended for crops. Therefore, weeding and hoeing should be carried out on time. Fertilisers should be applied in balanced quantities based on soil test results. Should farmers choose early-maturing varieties? Yes. Considering the effects of El Niño, farmers should choose short-duration, early-maturing varieties of wheat and mustard and sow them on time. This will allow the crops to mature fully before the intense sunshine and hot winds of March arrive. The grains of wheat and mustard will be less likely to shrivel, helping farmers avoid a fall in profits. Early-maturing varieties also require less irrigation to reach maturity, making them a better option for farmers during the dry conditions associated with El Niño.

stories.title: Daughter marries for love, UP father performs funeral rites:Says she tarnished family honour and is dead to him
stories.summary: On Saturday evening in Chandauli, a father performed the funeral rites of his living daughter. She had married a man from another caste without her family's consent. The father tried repeatedly to reason with her, but she refused to listen. Angry over his daughter's love marriage, he performed her shraddha rites on the day of Pitru Visarjan. The girl's father said, "I have no relationship with her now. She did not uphold our honour. Her decision has caused us deep pain. If she has brought disgrace on us, in what sense is she my daughter? She is dead to me." The incident took place in Jagdishray village, 3 km from the district headquarters. Married without the family's consent Prakash Singh, a farmer from Jagdish Rai village, has three children. His eldest daughter, Neha Singh (20), was in a relationship with Sawan (24), the son of Kishori Paswan, a Class IV employee in the village animal husbandry department. Two months ago, Neha left home with Sawan. Without her family's consent, she married her boyfriend in a court marriage. After the court marriage, Neha and Sawan began living as husband and wife in Sonbhadra city. Performed pind daan under a peepal tree 200 metres away The family made every effort to bring their daughter back, but she remained firm on her decision. She said she loved Sawan more than herself. She would not betray him. The two would stand by each other until their dying breath. Since then, the family had been angry with Neha. At 5 p.m. on Saturday, Neha's father, Prakash Singh, performed her last rites under a peepal tree about 200 metres from their home. Father said - hurt by his daughter's decision Prakash Singh said, "Parents make great sacrifices to raise their children and secure a better future for them. They want their children to include the family in major decisions in their lives and respect their feelings." He said, "Her marriage without the consent of her family caused me deep pain. Because of this pain and anger, I performed funeral rites for my daughter." Uncle said: The family educated the daughter Prakash Singh's younger brother, Pappu Singh, said, “Neha has graduated. The family raised her like a son. The family wanted Neha to marry within her caste. But her decision to marry a man from another caste hurt us. The family supports our elder brother's decision.”

stories.summary: आंवला से पूर्व सांसद धर्मेन्द्र कश्यप ने पार्टी छोड़ने के ऐलान के बाद अपना इस्तीफा सार्वजनिक करते हुए फेसबुक पर पोस्ट कर दिया। धर्मेन्द्र कश्यप के समर्थन में कई और लोगों ने भाजपा से इस्तीफा दे दिया।

stories.title: Follow-up: 68,500 शिक्षक भर्ती के अभ्यर्थियों का डॉ. संजय निषाद के आवास पर प्रदर्शन, घेराव कर उठाई मांगें
stories.summary: Teacher Recruitment Protest: उत्तर प्रदेश में 68,500 सहायक अध्यापक भर्ती-2018 में आरक्षण संबंधी विसंगतियों को दूर करने और पात्र अभ्यर्थियों को नियुक्ति देने की मांग को लेकर आंदोलन कर रहे अभ्यर्थियों ने शनिवार सुबह 11 बजे कैबिनेट मंत्री डॉ. संजय निषाद के आवास का घेराव कर प्रदर्शन किया। ‘दस्तक दो अभियान’ के तहत पहुंचे अभ्यर्थियों ने राज्य पिछड़ा वर्ग आयोग के आदेश का अनुपालन कराने, भर्ती परिणाम में संशोधन करने और पात्र अभ्यर्थियों को नियुक्ति देने की मांग उठाई। अभ्यर्थियों के मुताबिक, वे पिछले 40 दिनों से लखनऊ के ईको गार्डन धरना स्थल पर आंदोलन कर रहे हैं, लेकिन अब तक उनकी मांगों का अपेक्षित समाधान नहीं हो पाया है।

stories.summary: CJP Protest: समाजवादी पार्टी के सांसद शिवपाल सिंह पटेल ने भाजपा पर युवाओं के साथ दुश्मनों जैसा व्यवहार करने का आरोप लगाया है। उन्होंने कहा कि सरकार को युवाओं की मांगों को दबाने के बजाय उन्हें गंभीरता से सुनना चाहिए और उनकी समस्याओं पर ध्यान देना चाहिए। शिवपाल सिंह पटेल ने कहा कि अगर युवाओं की मांग के बाद धर्मेंद्र प्रधान को हटाया गया है, तो चीफ इलेक्शन कमिश्नर (मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त) को भी पद से हटा देना चाहिए।

stories.summary: Kangana Ranaut Lucknow: दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर पर CJP के आह्वान पर प्रस्तावित प्रदर्शन को लेकर राजनीतिक बयानबाजी तेज हो गई है। इस बीच भाजपा सांसद कंगना रनौत ने देश की सुरक्षा और राष्ट्रीय हितों से जुड़े मुद्दों पर चिंता जताई है। उन्होंने कहा कि मौजूदा समय में राष्ट्र विरोधी तत्व, आतंकवादी ताकतें और अंतरराष्ट्रीय साजिशें देश के लिए गंभीर चिंता का विषय बन गई हैं। उनके मुताबिक, अलग-अलग बहानों के जरिए देश और उसके नागरिकों को परेशान करने की कोशिशें की जा रही हैं। कंगना के इस बयान के बाद प्रदर्शन और उससे जुड़े मुद्दों पर राजनीतिक चर्चा तेज होने की संभावना है।

stories.title: Businessman shot dead with 4 bullets in Rampur:2 men in car open fire outside shop; he had married woman 10 years older than him for love
stories.summary: A 30-year-old businessman was shot dead in broad daylight in Rampur. He was sitting at his shop when the incident occurred. At around 5 p.m., two men arrived in a car and opened indiscriminate fire. The businessman was hit by four bullets. After seeing the firing, people nearby informed the police and the businessman's family. The police reached the spot and chased the assailants but could not apprehend them. Police officers took the businessman to hospital in critical condition, where he was declared dead. The incident took place in the Milak Khanam police station area, 40 km from the district headquarters. Navjot Singh, a resident of Tah Kala village, owned a Washing Hub shop in Kumaria Kala. He was his father's only son. His sister works in Canada, while his father is a farmer. The police's preliminary investigation has revealed that Navjot had a love marriage with a 40-year-old woman around a year ago. The woman's husband died around three years ago. She has two sons, both of whom work in New Zealand. The police are investigating the case from all angles.

stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Politics News: उत्तर प्रदेश के सिद्धार्थनगर में भाजपा सांसद जगदंबिका पाल ने एसआईआर (SIR) को लेकर विपक्ष पर निशाना साधा है। उन्होंने आरोप लगाया कि दिल्ली में इस मुद्दे पर विरोध के जरिए अराजकता फैलाने और जनता को परेशान करने की कोशिश की जा रही है। जगदंबिका पाल ने कहा कि चुनाव आयोग घर-घर जाकर सर्वे कर रहा है और जिन मतदाताओं की मौत हो चुकी है या जिनके नाम दो जगह दर्ज हैं, उन्हें मतदाता सूची से हटाया जा रहा है। उन्होंने राहुल गांधी पर झूठ फैलाने और विपक्ष पर इस मुद्दे पर राजनीति करने का आरोप भी लगाया।

stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh News: लखनऊ में उत्तर प्रदेश के मंत्री धर्मपाल सिंह ने एसआईआर (SIR) को लेकर विपक्ष पर निशाना साधा है। उन्होंने कहा कि विपक्ष इसलिए परेशान है, क्योंकि चुनावों में फर्जी वोट डलवाए जाते थे। धर्मपाल सिंह ने सवाल उठाया कि गलत वोट हटने से विपक्ष को परेशानी क्यों हो रही है। उन्होंने दावा किया कि साल 2027 के विधानसभा चुनाव में उत्तर प्रदेश में भाजपा भारी बहुमत से सरकार बनाएगी। मंत्री ने चुनाव आयोग के कामकाज की तारीफ करते हुए कहा कि जब विपक्ष चुनाव हारता है, तो ईवीएम पर सवाल उठाने लगता है।

stories.title: Akhilesh asks why BJP is shielding ECI:Says 'guilty conscience needs no accuser'; family pays tribute to Mulayam in Etawah
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav said in Saifai, "If the Opposition is protesting against the Election Commission, why is the BJP defending it? Weak governments resort to injustice. They put the police at the forefront." "This protest is against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar. It is not just one party that has raised questions about him; several political parties have done so. If anyone is plotting a conspiracy behind the Election Commission, it is the BJP." Akhilesh arrived on Saturday to pay tribute at the memorial of his father, former Defence Minister Mulayam Singh Yadav, on his death anniversary. A Socialist Museum is being built here in Mulayam Singh's memory. Akhilesh said- The Election Commission is a constitutional institution. Its responsibility is to take impartial decisions and maintain its credibility in a democracy. The BJP comes forward in every protest against the Chief Election Commissioner. This clearly means that the guilty conscience is showing. First 2 pictures Read the key points of Akhilesh's statement 1- All parties are united against the CEC The BJP wants the Election Commission to make a decision that would ensure voting rights only for those who are BJP members. In other words, only those who are BJP members would be considered citizens of India. Not only the youth but all political parties are united against this conspiracy. Everyone is demanding that the Election Commission remain impartial. Its current commissioner should resign. The Samajwadi Party has always maintained that goodness should be brought to the fore and evil should not be given space. 2- Protests will continue until the BJP is removed We will continue the fight until we remove the BJP from power. Once the BJP is removed, the Election Commission will also be reformed. For reforms in the Election Commission, people will have to cast every vote against the BJP. In a democracy, being taken into custody, being arrested and being hounded by the police are nothing new. Therefore, whenever there is an opportunity to protest and raise one's voice, it should be used. Leaders of all parties have met the President. The President has sought evidence in cases where a political party believes that the Election Commission has not treated it fairly. 3- Elections were influenced through administrative power The BJP tried to alter the election results by using the power of the Election Commission and the administration. In several places, police personnel were allowed to cast their votes in plain clothes. People's voting rights were taken away in widespread injustice during the by-elections. During the SIR (Special Intensive Revision), the Samajwadi Party's PDA watchdogs caught people who were being used to fill out Form 7 and get voters' names deleted. 4- Several voters' names deleted in Sultanpur Akhilesh said, "I want to cite the example of Sultanpur. Attempts were made to get the names of several Samajwadi Party voters deleted by forging Nandlal Nishad's signature. When we brought Nandlal Nishad forward and asked him why he had signed and filled out Form 7, he said that he did not even know how to sign." You can imagine that fake signatures were being made in the name of people who did not know how to sign and used their thumb impressions, so that voters' names could be deleted. 5- Irregularities were committed in Lucknow's Sarojini Nagar Assembly constituency More than 100 Form 7s were submitted in the name of Dashrath in Lucknow's Sarojini Nagar Assembly constituency. When our PDA sentinels detected the matter and it was investigated, it emerged that under the rules, no person can submit more than five Form 7s. Despite this, more than 100 forms were submitted in Dashrath's name. What could be a bigger example of this? You may also remember the image from Mirapur in which a police officer tried to stop people from voting by pointing a revolver at them. He did not want the women to go and vote. They had to fight for their right to vote before they could cast their ballots. 6- The Election Commission must prove its impartiality Akhilesh said, "I want to say that the Election Commission is a constitutional body. It will have to prove its impartiality and credibility. It is no longer a credible institution. Voices are being raised from every section of society that the people sitting in the Election Commission are committing fraud." 7- Mamata Didi was deliberately defeated If someone's name is deleted from the electoral roll, they may also be deprived of the government's welfare schemes and other facilities. How can we forget the West Bengal election? Didi was deliberately defeated there. She did not lose; she was made to lose. The election was stolen by deploying a force of more than three lakh people. This time, a large photograph of Akhilesh Yadav's mother, Malti Devi, was also placed near Mulayam Singh's memorial. All the leaders laid flowers before it as well. However, Samajwadi Party national general secretary Ram Gopal Yadav was not seen at the event.

stories.title: Yogi accepts Akhilesh’s Ayodhya challenge:Says, 'Why fight your followers? You contest, I will too; let’s face off'
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath accepted Akhilesh Yadav’s challenge to contest the election from Ayodhya. Speaking in Balrampur on Saturday, he said, “You contest from Ayodhya, and I will too. You file your nomination from Ayodhya, and I will file mine. Let us try our luck once. Why fight through aides? The contest should be face-to-face. Let us face each other once.” He said, The SP’s Babua is already rattled. These are the people who bow before mafias and offer prayers at their graves. How can they fight us? They do not have the courage. The public has already shown them the door in the past. They are now in a situation like a frustrated cat scratching a post. Yogi further said, “Akhilesh ji, Ayodhya is our sacred abode. I visit Ayodhya repeatedly to ensure that there is no negligence in its development and that the identity of Uttar Pradesh is not tarnished in any way. Ayodhya is a place of faith for us. We visit it not to contest elections but to ensure its development.” Akhilesh had challenged CM Yogi on Friday, saying, “If the Chief Minister, who makes tall claims, is so confident, he should contest the election from Ayodhya himself.” He added that this time, the people of Ayodhya and the entire country would not spare those who steal religion and wealth. Read the CM’s key statements 1. ‘SP’s Babua is already rattled’ Yogi said, “SP’s Babua is already rattled. Development has only just begun, and much more remains to be done. During the SP government, Ayodhya received only three to four hours of electricity. Obstacles were created to hinder development. Today, Ayodhya is reminding us of the Treta Yuga as a new example of Ram Rajya. The NDA will win 80% of the seats in the upcoming Assembly elections, while the opposition will get a maximum of 20%.” 2. ‘SP’s PDA stands for Parivar Development Authority’ The CM said, “SP’s PDA actually stands for ‘Parivar Development Authority’. It can also mean ‘Pradesh Dubao Alliance’ (alliance to sink the state). In the Rajya Sabha elections, the SP neglected Dalits, backward classes and other sections. One seat was given to a family member, while the other was allocated on the basis of financial muscle. There is no place in the SP’s agenda for anyone outside the family.” 3. ‘Credit victory to themselves, blame EVMs for defeat’ Yogi said, “When these parties win elections, they credit their own efforts. When they lose, they blame EVMs, question the Election Commission and comment on the courts.” He also accused previous governments of corruption, riots and protecting criminals. He said no one could incite riots in the state now. 4. ‘We will not allow people like Chhangur to flourish’ Yogi said, “No one like Chhangur will be allowed to flourish here. No one will be allowed to change the demography. During the previous SP government, this region had become a hub for smuggling and criminal activities. Now, the same region is moving forward with new development opportunities.” 5. ‘Those who endanger girls’ safety will go to hell’ Yogi said mafias and criminals were protected under previous governments, emboldening offenders and leaving ordinary citizens living in fear. He said the rule of law now prevails in the state and the government follows a zero-tolerance policy towards crime and criminals. No mafia will be allowed to undermine law and order. “Those who endanger the safety of girls have no third option apart from jail or hell,” he said. Story being updated...

stories.title: Sister dies by suicide after brother’s death:She was in shock after his death; they argued over eating ghee before the tragedy
stories.summary: A dispute broke out between a brother and sister in Mirzapur over eating too much ghee. The following morning, Saturday (10 Oct), the brother allegedly died by suicide after hanging himself from the railing of a well. Sister dies by suicide after learning of brother’s death On learning about her brother’s death, the sister was reportedly left in shock. While family members went to the well to bring down his body, she allegedly died by suicide using her dupatta in another room of the house. When the family brought the brother’s body home, they found the girl hanging. They rushed her to a hospital, where doctors declared her dead. 18-year-old was training in wrestling The deceased, Sheshnath, 18, was pursuing his intermediate studies and receiving wrestling training from his father. The incident took place within the jurisdiction of Adalhat police station. Son was learning wrestling from his father Ram Aasare Yadav lives with his family in Hajipur village. A wrestler by profession and a farmer, he lives with his wife, Geeta, and their four children: eldest son Lavkush (25), daughter Anushka (21), Sheshnath alias Goli (18), and youngest son Ankush (17). Sheshnath was studying in intermediate, while Anushka was pursuing a BA degree. Father trains village children at a temple akhara A Hanuman temple is located around 100 metres from Ram Aasare’s house. An akhara has been set up within the temple premises, where he trains children from the village in wrestling. Sheshnath was also learning the sport from his father alongside his studies. As he prepared to become a wrestler, he paid particular attention to his diet. Argument over ghee during dinner The family was having dinner together on Friday night when Sheshnath took out more ghee than needed. His sister, Anushka, closed the container and put it away, triggering an argument between the two. Family members intervened and calmed them down. Later, everyone went to sleep. Family thought he had gone for wrestling practice Sheshnath would wake up at 5 am every day to practise wrestling at the akhara. On Saturday morning, he left home as usual, and his family assumed he had gone to practise. A well is located on the temple premises, where a rope and bucket are kept for drawing water. Sheshnath used the rope to hang himself from the well’s railing. Brother’s body brought home; sister found hanging soon after Some villagers arrived at the wrestling arena for practice and found Sheshnath’s body hanging from the railing of a well. They immediately informed his family, whose members rushed towards the temple after receiving the news. Anushka woke up amid the commotion and learnt of her brother’s death. She was reportedly left in shock by the news. Family rushes sister to hospital, but doctors declare her dead When the family returned home with Sheshnath’s body at around 6 am, they found Anushka hanging from a dupatta. They immediately brought her down and rushed her to hospital, where doctors declared her dead. The deaths of the brother and sister plunged the family into grief. Neighbour Omkar Yadav said that he was informed about the incident at around 5:30 a.m. The sister went into shock after hearing about her brother's death. While family members were taking her brother down from the noose, she went to another room and hanged herself. Adalhat police station in-charge Baijnath said, “The bodies have been sent for post-mortem examinations. The family members have not accused anyone. Further action will be taken on the basis of the complaint and the post-mortem reports.”

stories.title: Businessman dies after fall from girlfriend’s flat in Lucknow:Mother alleges murder, police probe if victim was pushed
stories.summary: A businessman died after falling from the fourth floor of an apartment in Lucknow. He was taken to hospital, but died on the way. His mother has accused his girlfriend of murdering him. The businessman, Shiva Sharma, had been living with his girlfriend for the past four months. His girlfriend, Shraddha Dubey, is a social media influencer with 141,000 followers on Instagram. She has also appeared in a few music albums. Shiva Sharma ran a clothing shop named Vande Mataram Chicken and a restaurant called Aangan. Police are investigating whether he was pushed, along with other possible angles. The incident took place at around 10 pm on Friday at Awadh Green Apartments in the Hazratganj police station area. Read what the mother stated in the FIR Shiva's family lives at C-40 in Sector F, Aliganj. His mother, Ranjana Sharma, said, "My son Shiva Sharma had been living in with a girl named Shraddha Dubey for the past four months. She used to threaten to have my son sent to jail in a case by falsely accusing him. She wanted my son to stay with her. She used to blackmail him in various ways." At around 7 p.m. on 9 October, Shraddha Dubey and her sister's driver, Adil, called me to say that Shiva was unwell and was being taken to hospital. A little later, Adil told me that they were taking Shiva to KGMU. When we reached KGMU, everyone, including Shraddha, fled after showing us Shiva's body. My son had suffered several injuries. He was wearing only underwear. Makeup had been applied to his body. Shraddha Dubey, driver Adil, her sister Rashmi Dubey and others have killed my son. Shraddha Dubey had assaulted my son in the past as well. Now read the allegations made by the mother Driver fled as soon as he saw the family Mother Ranjana Sharma alleged that when she reached the emergency department at the medical college, Danish, the driver of Shraddha's sister Rashmi, was standing beside the ambulance. As soon as he saw the family, Danish fled, leaving the ambulance and Shiva behind. When we questioned the ambulance driver, he said he had been going back and forth between Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital and the medical college for three hours. After that, when we took Shiva inside to have him admitted, the doctors declared him dead. Eyes and jaw broken, burned with a cigarette The mother alleged that this was not an accident but a premeditated murder. There were signs of brutality and assault on her son's body. Both of Shiva's eyes and his jaw were fractured. A large amount of blood was flowing from his nose and ears. His leg and ribs were also broken. His entire body bore cigarette-burn marks and scratches. Shiva was held captive, brutally beaten and murdered. The girl had been harassing her son for four to five months Ranjana Sharma says that Shraddha Dubey had been harassing her son for four to five months. She threatened to assault him, level false allegations against him and defame him in society. About six to seven days ago, Shraddha also came to our shop. She threatened us, saying that we should hand over our son or face consequences we could not even imagine. They were keeping watch around our house and shop. Demand for police action Ranjana said that on 8 October, Shraddha's driver Danish took the keys of the Fortuner from their house and tried to drive away with the vehicle. When they objected, he abandoned the vehicle and fled. ACP Rajneesh Verma said- The causes of the incident are being investigated. The young man had fallen from the fourth floor. A case has been registered. Strict action will be taken.

stories.title: Chinese kite string cuts youth’s neck, killing him:Banned in UP for 10 years, yet still sold; govt had ordered murder FIRs
stories.summary: A 35-year-old man died after Chinese manjha slit his neck in Gorakhpur. He was riding a scooter to a shop at around 1 pm on Saturday when the sharp kite string got caught around his neck. He applied the brakes, but by then, his neck had already been partially slit. The man fell onto the road along with his scooter, and blood began pouring from his neck. Passers-by rushed to help him and took him to the district hospital, where doctors declared him dead. The victim was identified as Ramesh Kannaujia. The incident took place in the Tiwari pur police station area of the city. On receiving the news, his wife rushed to the district hospital in tears and insisted on seeing her husband's face. The police initially refused but later allowed her to see him. The SP has suspended the police outpost in-charge in connection with the incident. Chinese manjha has been banned in Uttar Pradesh for the past 10 years, yet it continues to be sold. In February this year, the state government said that if someone dies due to Chinese manjha, the incident would not be treated as an accident. Instead, an FIR for murder would be registered. See two pictures... Man was the sole breadwinner of his family Ramesh Kannaujia was the only earning member of his family. He worked at a cosmetics shop and earned Rs 10,000 to Rs 12,000 a month. His family comprises his wife, Punna, nine-year-old daughter Aparna, five-year-old son Aryan and elderly father Fakire. Ramesh was also responsible for looking after his father. His father, Fakire, said Ramesh had left for the shop on his scooter. Half an hour later, a man arrived and informed the family about the accident. They rushed to the hospital, but his son had already died. Doctor says he died before reaching hospital Dr RD Raman at the district hospital said the injured man had died before reaching the hospital. The body has been sent for a post-mortem. Only after the examination will it be possible to determine how severely his neck was cut or whether he died from a head injury sustained in the fall. Locals say Chinese manjha is still being sold despite ban Local residents allege that Chinese manjha is being sold secretly at 10 shops despite the ban. They questioned who would now support Ramesh’s family and take responsibility for his children. They urged the administration to take strict action to stop the sale of the banned kite string. SP City says strict action will be taken against sellers SP City Nimish Patil said an FIR has been registered in the case. Domingarh police outpost in-charge Alok Singh has been suspended. A drive will be conducted over the next 48 hours to prevent the sale and use of Chinese manjha. Strict action will be taken against anyone found selling it, he said. February 4, 2026: MR Shoaib died in Lucknow after his neck was slit by Chinese manjha. January 14, 2026: Doctor Sameer died in Jaunpur after Chinese manjha slit his neck. October 23, 2025: Ravi Sharma, 26, was travelling to his in-laws’ house with his wife in Shahjahanpur when Chinese manjha got caught around his neck. He died in hospital. September 30, 2025: Salman, 28, was riding his scooter to a shop in Aligarh when Chinese manjha became entangled around his neck, causing a deep cut. He died after being taken to hospital. January 11, 2025: Constable Shahrukh Hasan was on his way to duty in Shahjahanpur when he was caught by Chinese manjha. He suffered a deep cut to his neck and died during treatment.

stories.title: 11-year-old dies of electrocution at school in Ghazipur:Came in contact with broken live wire while playing on swing
stories.summary: An 11-year-old boy died of electrocution at a private school in Ghazipur on Saturday morning. He had reached the school at 7.30 am to sit an exam. Before the exam began, he went to play on a swing in the playground. A broken electric wire was lying nearby, and he came into contact with it. Other children raised the alarm, following which school staff arrived. The boy was taken to hospital in the school van, where doctors declared him dead. The incident took place at Danish Memorial Public School in the Jangipur police station area, around 5 km from the district headquarters. The student, Utkarsh, was in Class 3 and was his parents’ only child. Mother says wire was already broken, but no repairs were carried out Dilip Gupta is a resident of Govind Nagar in the city. His family comprises his wife and two children. Utkarsh’s sister is two-and-a-half years old. His mother, Kiran, said through tears, “An electric wire on the school premises had already broken. The children had informed us about it at home, but no repairs were carried out despite this. “If the wire had been repaired in time, my son’s life could have been saved. The school authorities initially tried to hide the incident. When we insisted on knowing what had happened, they told us that he had been taken to Sadar Hospital. When we reached there, we found our son’s body.” School manager says monkeys broke the wire School manager Mohammad Shariq Qureshi said, “I was away when the incident took place. The child had reached school before the scheduled time. There is a problem with monkeys on the school premises, and they had broken the electric wire. “The woman responsible for cleaning the school had arrived in the morning, but she did not notice the wire. The child died after coming into contact with it.”

stories.title: First wife kills husband in Kushinagar:Attacks second wife, who tries to save him; dispute arose over land sale
stories.summary: A farmer was killed in Kushinagar at around 6 a.m. on Saturday. His first wife and their children attacked him with a sharp-edged weapon in a banana field around 300 metres from the house. His second wife, who came to save him, was also attacked. She suffered deep wounds to her neck and head. After she lost consciousness, the accused first wife fled the scene with the children. The incident took place in Jungle Chaudiya village, under Padrauna police station, around 10 km from the district headquarters. Police forces from two stations reached the spot after receiving the information. The body was taken into custody, and the injured woman was admitted to the district hospital. The second wife has not regained consciousness yet. See two pictures Complete story details Om Prakash Rajbhar (50), a resident of Jungle Jagdishpur village in the Nebua Naurangia police station area, had married twice. His first wife, Urmila, is an ASHA worker. They have three daughters and a son, Ajit. The eldest daughter is married, while the other two daughters, Kajal and Seema, are unmarried. Om Prakash married his second wife, Nitya, 18 years ago. They have a son and a daughter. He cultivates bananas and owns more than five bighas of land. A dispute over the land had been ongoing within the family. His first wife had also filed a maintenance-related case against her husband in court. Land had been sold just a few days earlier The daughter of Omprakash's second wife said tearfully, My father was beaten by his first wife and her children. They also attacked my mother. My father, Omprakash, had sold part of his ancestral land a few days ago. Urmila was demanding money from her share. She and her children were angry over this. They had also quarrelled several times in the past. Quarrel took place in the morning CO Sadar Rakesh Pratap Singh said that the two had argued again on Saturday morning. The matter was settled afterwards, and Omprakash left for his field. His first wife, Urmila, who had been living separately because of the dispute, was working on building a boundary ridge in the field that day. During this time, an argument broke out with her husband, Omprakash, when he reached the spot, followed by an assault. The first wife and her children assaulted Omprakash. They struck him on the head and abdomen and killed him. Hearing the commotion, his second wife, Nitya, reached the spot, where the accused attacked her as well. They fled the scene, leaving her in a critical condition. Afterwards, when villagers reached the spot, they found the second wife unconscious. The police were informed immediately. The police admitted the injured second wife to hospital. The farmer's body was taken into custody and sent for a post-mortem examination. CMS says woman suffered serious head injury, referred to Gorakhpur CMS Dr Dileep Kumar said, "The woman brought to the hospital had serious injuries at several places on her head and body and was unconscious. In view of the serious head injury, she was referred to Gorakhpur after receiving first aid." First wife fled with children after the incident CO Sadar Rakesh Pratap Singh said The first wife and the children carried out the murder. Three special teams have been formed to arrest the accused. The accused will be arrested soon.

stories.title: 4 devotees returning from Shakumbhari Devi shrine killed:Container hits trolley carrying Navratri flame to Meerut; victims thrown 10 feet away
stories.summary: Four devotees were killed in a road accident in Saharanpur, while more than 20 others were injured. They had gone to offer prayers at Shakambhari Devi temple and were travelling to Meerut with the Navratri sacred flame. At 8 a.m. on Saturday, they had stopped at a tea stall in Deoband for breakfast. During this time, an out-of-control container truck rammed into the tractor-trolley from behind. The collision was so powerful that the people sitting in the trolley were thrown out and landed on the road 10 feet away. Hearing their cries, local residents reached the spot. The police were called, and the injured were taken to the district hospital by ambulance. The accident took place in the Deoband police station area, around 48 kilometres from the district headquarters. As soon as he received the information, District Magistrate Arvind Chauhan reached the hospital and asked the injured about the incident. The deceased were identified as Aman Rana (25), Ramesh alias Rinku (55), Sagar (22) and Pankaj (25), all residents of Kushawali village in Sardhana, Meerut. See pictures of the accident- Devotee Sunil said: Navratri begins on Sunday, so we had gone to the Shakambhari Devi Temple to collect the sacred flame. While returning, we stopped at a shop in Deoband for tea and water. Some people had got down, while others were sitting in the trolley. The container then crashed into it.

stories.title: Factory owner beaten to death, CCTV captures attack:Dispute over smoke in Saharanpur; men attack him after he refuses to shut factory
stories.summary: A factory owner was beaten to death in Saharanpur over a dispute regarding smoke from his tyre-to-oil extraction unit. According to the police, a group of local men carried out the attack. On Friday night, 10–15 villagers arrived at the factory armed with sticks and demanded that the owner shut it down. He refused. Angered by his refusal, the villagers surrounded and assaulted factory owner Arbeen Chauhan, 45. His nephew, Sadiq, was also beaten when he tried to save him. The accused fled, leaving both men critically injured. Their family members took them to hospital, where the factory owner died during treatment. CCTV footage of the incident has emerged, showing the accused assaulting Arbeen. The police have registered a case against 11 people and arrested the main accused. The incident took place in the Gangoh police station area, around 55 km from the district headquarters. The tyre-to-oil extraction factory has an annual turnover of ₹ 5 crore. It had permission to operate from the administration and the pollution control department. Read the full account of the incident in the injured nephew’s words Arbeen Chauhan was a resident of Mannamajra in Shamli district. His nephew, Sadiq, said: “My uncle has a tyre-to-oil extraction factory in Salarpura, Saharanpur. I was at the factory with him on Friday night when some villagers arrived carrying sticks and rods and entered the premises. Neeraj and his brother were among them. “They told the employees to shut down the factory. When the employees refused, they started abusing and assaulting them. Hearing the commotion, my uncle and I went there. As soon as they saw my uncle, they began abusing him. They said smoke from the factory was causing pollution in the village. “They said they would not allow the factory to operate and demanded that it be shut down immediately. When my uncle refused, the accused dragged him out of the factory and began beating him with sticks and rods. When I tried to save him, they assaulted me too.” Factory was set up five years ago The employees called the factory owner's family and informed them about the incident. The family then alerted the police and reached the factory. They took both injured men to hospital, where Arbeen Chauhan died. His nephew, Sadiq, is undergoing treatment. The factory was set up five years ago at a cost of Rs 1.5 crore. Spread across 10 bighas, it is located 300 metres from the village. Villagers had been complaining about smoke from the factory for the past two years. Whenever they approached the owner, he would show them the permission letter and send them away. Accused says, ‘I am innocent’ Police have arrested Neeraj, the main accused in the murder case. He said, “Smoke comes out of the tyre factory every day. There is a fear that it could cause cancer. Villagers have complained to the factory owner several times, but he paid no attention. “On Friday, around 20 villagers and I went to meet the factory owner. We intended to discuss the factory with him, but as soon as he saw us, he had the gate closed. When we tried to get the gate opened, he and his employees started assaulting us. “They beat me, my brother and other villagers. I was trying to separate people, but we were assaulted. I do not know what happened after that. I have done nothing wrong. I am innocent.” Nephew says uncle was murdered for refusing to pay extortion money Arbeen Chauhan’s other nephew, Furkan Chaudhary, said, “My uncle set up the factory around two years ago. Some people were demanding extortion money from him, but he refused. This is why he was murdered. If anyone had a complaint about the factory, they should have approached the administration. “Arriving at night with weapons, bringing 20–25 people and vandalising the property is unacceptable. My uncle died in their attack. We demand that the police arrest all the accused and take strict action against them.” Kotwali in-charge Indresh Chauhan said, “There was a dispute between the factory owner and villagers over smoke coming from the factory. They got into a fight, in which one person died and another was injured. A case has been registered based on a complaint filed by the victim’s family. CCTV footage is being examined, and the accused will be arrested soon.”

stories.title: BSF at Noida-Delhi border, tankers and ambulances stationed:Leaders placed under house arrest in Lucknow amid CJP protest
stories.summary: Security has been tightened along the Uttar Pradesh border after the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) announced a protest at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar. Barricades have been erected along the UP border in Ghaziabad, where more than 100 police personnel have been deployed. Vehicles are being allowed to enter only after checks. Security has also been tightened at the Chilla border between Delhi and Noida. BSF personnel have been deployed and cement barricades installed. Large water tankers, buses and ambulances have also been stationed there for use if required. More than 100 trains from Uttar Pradesh to New Delhi and Hazrat Nizamuddin stations have been cancelled due to the protest, affecting around 1.5 lakh passengers. The Rapid Rail service from Meerut to Delhi will operate only up to Anand Vihar. Meanwhile, CPI(ML) Liberation district secretary Ramesh Sengar has been placed under house arrest in Lucknow. stories.title: Varanasi showroom fire:Blaze erupts at jewellery and saree store; smoke fills closed building near Akashvani, firefighters enter via stairs
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out on Saturday morning at Banaras Swarn Kala Kendra, a jewellery and sari showroom near Akashvani in Varanasi's Bhelupur police station area. Panic spread in the area after flames and smoke were seen rising from the showroom. As soon as the incident was reported, a fire brigade team reached the spot and began efforts to extinguish the blaze. Six fire tenders and one rescue team were deployed given the severity of the fire. Firefighters brought the blaze under control after around three hours of strenuous efforts. Chief Fire Officer (CFO) Anand Singh Rajput said, "We received information about the fire at around 6 a.m. Fire tenders and a rescue team were immediately sent to the site. Firefighters reached the upper section with the help of ladders and extinguished the fire, preventing it from spreading to other parts of the showroom." See three pictures... Fire broke out in locked building, short circuit suspected According to CFO Anand Singh Rajput, the building where the fire broke out was completely locked. A short circuit is suspected to have caused the fire in the preliminary investigation. However, the actual cause of the fire has not yet been ascertained. An investigation is under way. He said the incident occurred in the morning, so no repair work was being carried out in the building at the time. The building's owners also lived there. Therefore, all aspects are being investigated to determine the cause of the fire. Stock, chairs and reception area kept on first floor burnt The CFO said that the first floor of the building housed a stock room, along with some chairs and part of the reception area. This section was partially burnt in the fire. However, the total damage has not yet been assessed. He said that firefighters had saved the sari showroom on the first floor from the fire. No damage was reported in this section. The exact point from which the fire started and the quantity of goods damaged will be known only after a detailed investigation and assessment. Firefighters reached the upper floors via the stairs According to CFO Anand Singh Rajput, the smoke remained trapped inside the building because it had glass panels. This made it challenging for firefighters to put out the fire. The team reached the upper floors using ladders and attempted to bring the fire under control. He said firefighters first placed a ladder and controlled the fire on the first floor to prevent the flames from spreading to other areas. They then continued their efforts until the fire was completely extinguished. Two to three fire department personnel reportedly sustained minor injuries during the operation.
